scope: 23 observed public non-archived repositories; repository search and visibility checks; no vendor enrollment or pin promotion

entries.verification: 8 focused tests passed before and after merge; 34 listed paths equal survey selection; full committed inventory check passed; all five Python CI versions and JUnit collector passed

entries.use_case: 保存結果をID・列・条件で選んで表示する

entries.use_case: 画面の責務・到達性・未分類状態を抽出する

entries.verification: 34 focused tests passed; four default CLI modes byte-identical; excluded missing ID still fails check

entries.use_case: checkout・Git/gh有無・対象PR/SHA/CIを確認する

entries.verification: Real adopted ghi used by python -S preflight; current upstream source reviewed; no vendor pin changed
entries.limitations: Token presence is not authentication/permissions; runtime uses the existing adopted pin, not upstream main.

entries.use_case: ページ・環境を選んで画像比較シートを生成する

entries.verification: Prior wave: 64 consumer tests plus actual Ironmate stdlib comparison/digest passed; remote merge rechecked
entries.limitations: Implementation lives in the browser-test-kit consumer; no duplicate Ironmate change needed.

entries.use_case: 必要な変換ケースだけ往復変換・差分比較する

entries.verification: 25 focused tests, standalone CLI/default JSON compatibility and final functional CI passed

entries.verification: 57 focused tests, standalone CLI/default compatibility and final functional CI passed

entries.use_case: 用途・入口・接続先・検証状態を継続して照合する

entries.verification: 3 focused preflight tests; 1294 full tests plus 50 subtests passed, 64 skipped; existing stdlib runtime smoke passed; independent review passed

entries.use_case: 検証済みlab公開exportを出版ID付きのツール導線へ取り込む

entries.use_case: 定義済み処理を実行前にdoctor/showで確認する

entries.verification: explicit CPE helpers, CVSS 9.8 and complete-zero versus unmeasured; 342 subtests
entries.limitations: Offline primitives only. No live CVE retrieval, applicability verdict, or automatic package-to-CPE mapping.

entries.use_case: 条件候補を比較し反例を残す

entries.verification: c001 comparison: 156 units, 17 existing and 16 derived candidates; best MCC 0.8207826816681233
